acceptance_contract.quality: candidate must satisfy every required answer field
acceptance_contract.price: candidate short- and long-context price-equivalent scenarios must both be strictly lower when request-level context classification is unavailable
acceptance_contract.mechanism: a round-reduction claim additionally requires fewer observed command interactions; structural counts are not per-request billing
acceptance_contract.stop: one quality, price, identity, or mechanism failure stops expansion for that candidate

conclusions.claim: shorter once-visible tool output alone lowers end-to-end cost
conclusions.evidence: experiment 198016c2 had 15.902% less visible tool output but 181.752% more total tokens because the interaction chain expanded

conclusions.claim: extra model-tool interaction cycles can dominate token and price
conclusions.status: strongly supported within the declared identity, not a universal per-call coefficient
conclusions.evidence: experiment 198016c2 increased commands from 5 to 11 while visible tool output fell; input and both price scenarios nearly doubled

conclusions.claim: raw command count alone predicts token or price
conclusions.evidence: experiment 081059d7 had the same three commands on both sides but lower candidate input and both price scenarios after reducing visible evidence volume

conclusions.claim: a generalized static rule is sufficient to guarantee fewer rounds and complete answers
conclusions.status: falsified for all three tested rule shapes
conclusions.evidence: none of the candidates reduced command count and every candidate missed required answer facts

conclusions.claim: targeted large-page batching may lower price
conclusions.status: supported as a direction, not accepted
conclusions.evidence: experiment 081059d7 reduced visible tool output by 39.727% and short/long price by 25.182%/26.763%, but quality failed and one recovery command remained

repository_decision.matrix_expansion: not run because the first selected case never passed complete quality and mechanism together
repository_decision.reopen_condition: a new mechanism must first eliminate command-shape errors and pagination without project-specific anchors, then pass every required field and strictly lower both price scenarios before C++ or C# expansion

limitations: Each identity has one control and one candidate run, so no repeat variance is estimated.
The runner exposes subject-aggregate usage, not per-sampling-request usage or request context class.
Command counts are structural observations and are not exact model sampling counts.
The evidence is limited to the declared TypeScript snapshot and gpt-5.6-luna medium/default.
Detached semantic audits found candidate quality failures; price improvements cannot override them.
